olivia (ml-eng): heads up — onboarding Solace's customer adapter set. I merged two LoRA checkpoints (solace/lora_v1 + solace/lora_domainB) and the outputs look noisy after quantizing to int4. noticed a tokenizer mismatch warning during the merge. anyone run into token index shifts with a SentencePiece variant?
raj (applied-ml): @olivia yes, if tokenizers differ you'll get embedding index misalign. did you check vocab overlap? usually a shift of a handful of special tokens causes big downstream drift. :eyes:
olivia (ml-eng): ran a quick diff, overlap ~81-83%. output snippet:```
$ python tools/tokenizer_diff.py --a models/base/tokenizer.json --b customers/solace/tokenizer.json
OVERLAP: 82%
SPECIAL_SHIFT: +6 (customer has 6 extra entries at start)
```
tess (solutions): that explains it. for Solace we should either remap indices or rebase their tokenizer to the base one. which is less risky for their infra?
raj (applied-ml): remap is safer for a quick ship. we have adapter_stitch with --align-tokenizer flag that rewrites LoRA key offsets. try:```
python tools/adapter_stitch.py \\ 
  --base models/base/ggml-model.bin \\ 
  --lora customers/solace/lora_v1.pt customers/solace/lora_domainB.pt \\ 
  --align-tokenizer customers/solace/tokenizer.json \\ 
  --out builds/solace/merged_aligned.pt
```
olivia (ml-eng): did that. merged_aligned runs better but int4 quantization still drops intent_f1. quick eval pack "solace-smoke-03" metrics: base: intent_f1=0.92, merged_aligned=float32=0.90, merged_aligned+int4=0.81. embedding sim also down ~0.06.
kai (qa): can you paste the eval breakdown? curious if specific intents or generative turns degrade more.
olivia (ml-eng): pasted top-line and a small sample in the run logs:```
RUN: solace-smoke-03
metrics:
  intent_f1:
    base: 0.92
    merged_aligned_fp32: 0.90
    merged_aligned_int4: 0.81
  embed_cos_sim_mean:
    base: 0.87
    merged_aligned_int4: 0.81
sample_failures:
  - input: "Find invoice status"
    expected: "invoice_lookup_flow"
    merged_int4: "I can help with that, please provide..." (hallucinated follow-up)
```
raj (applied-ml): int4 here seems to amplify the tokenizer misalignment residue. try two experiments: (1) per-layer scaling calibration using 128-step calibration set (2) float16 merge for critical layers + int4 elsewhere. i can spin up both.
tess (solutions): flagging customer for slight delay; propose fallback policy — if merged_int4 confidence < 0.6 route to dedicated fp16 model. customers prefer small latency bump over hallucinations.
ci-bot: CI: eval run solace-smoke-03 completed. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/runs/2143654321-solace-smoke-03 :white_check_mark:
olivia (ml-eng): thanks. raj — can you take experiment (1) first? i'll collect a 128-example calibration set from Solace's dev corpus. ping me when ready and i'll run the rollout canary. :thumbsup:
raj (applied-ml): on it. will post diffs and a small script to apply per-layer scales. quick note: also check kv-cache tokenization when using streaming — different token offsets can break prefix caching. seen that with adapter merges before.
olivia (ml-eng): noted. adding to the checklist. planning to create a canary route with automatic fallback to fp16 for first 24h. will update here with results. :rocket:
